title: Chinese company Kunlun Tech has released Matrix-Game 4.0, an open-source system that lets AI generate a playable game in real time on a single consumer graphics card.
key_facts: Kunlun Tech released Matrix-Game 4.0 on 15 Oct 2026, code, weights and assets open-sourced
Claims first video foundation model game on a single consumer GPU (RTX 5090), 480p at 60 FPS, latency under 150 ms
External game engine maintains world state; video model renders frames from structural frames
Measured latency 112 ms vs 10.2 s, 545 ms and 878 ms for three other systems, per Kunlun's comparison
Peak VRAM 18.5 GiB; other systems need H200, GB200 or H100 data-centre cards
Built on Wan2.2 5B video model; coding agent lets players change terrain and NPC behaviour by text
Data from Kunlun's official technical comparison
quote_evidence: On October 15, 2026, Kunlun Tech officially released Matrix-Game 4.0, which it claims is the world's first video foundation model game running on a single consumer-grade GPU.
The project's code, weights, and white-box assets have been open-sourced simultaneously.
Note: Data sourced from Kunlun Tech's official technical comparison.
why_it_matters_hint: Shows AI-rendered interactive games moving from data-centre hardware to a single gaming card.
notes: Full text read. All performance claims are Kunlun's own.
